home.title: Track Matches. Share Feedback. Elevate Player Performance.
home.subtitle: The professional player tracker portal designed to record pitch minutes, log goals and assists, evaluate tactical ratings, and share trainer reflections.

stats.perf_desc: Track every metric including goals, assists, physical intensity, and attitude.
stats.collab_desc: Bridge the feedback loop with self-reflections and professional evaluations.
stats.active_desc: Instant dashboard reviews, status updates, and custom development paths.

home.features_subtitle: Designed to give you deep insights into match performances and development.

features.scheduling_desc: Log league games, cup fixtures, friendlies, and training sessions. Keep all match parameters organized.
features.metrics_desc: Grade performances with specific parameters like Work Intensity, Team Attitude, and Tactical Execution.
features.feedback_desc: Trainers can review logs and provide expert critique, while players log self-reflections to evaluate their strengths, weaknesses, and improvement plans.

home.workflow_player_desc: Log your own match minutes, input statistics, write self-reflections on what went right, note your key strengths or weaknesses, and build development plans under trainer reviews.
home.workflow_trainer_desc: Oversee matches, assign tactical marks (scores out of 10), review player inputs, and leave expert technical feedback to boost player development.
home.cta_subtitle: Sign up to build player files, log matches, and start analyzing statistics with teammates.

about_page.title: Agent Matches Hub
about_page.subtitle: Welcome to the ultimate player tracker application. Designed for teams, trainers, and aspiring athletes, Agent Matches bridges quantitative statistics with qualitative feedback to elevate player development.
about_page.features_subtitle: Select a category below to explore how we track player development.
about_page.db_note: * Saved directly inside database using Prisma ORM

tracking.title: Match Tracking & Log
tracking.description: Organize every game, training session, or friendly with rich contextual data. Know where, when, and who you played.
features: Track Match Types: League, Cup, Friendly, or Training sessions
Record opponent name, location, and match date/time
Manage status workflows: Scheduled, Completed, or Cancelled

performance.title: Player Performance Statistics
performance.description: Hard data is the key to tracking progress. Log standard key indicators for each player's match contribution.
features: Log goals scored and goal assists in every match
Track exact minutes played to measure stamina and workload
Accumulate data over time to view seasonal averages

metrics.title: Core Evaluation Metrics
metrics.description: Evaluate qualitative performance using our standard 1-10 scoring sliders to track physical and psychological indicators.
features: Mark: Standard score representing the overall performance quality
Intensity: Physical engagement and workload rate during the match
Attitude: Sportspersonship, team spirit, and mental resilience
Performance: Tactical execution and consistency on the pitch

collaboration.title: Trainer & Player Collaboration
collaboration.description: Build communication between trainers and players. Combine structured feedback with player self-reflections.
features: Trainer Feedback: Expert guidance and tactical instructions from trainers
Player Reflection: Self-evaluation space for players to express feelings
General Match Comments: Contextual notes on tactical patterns or events

mockData.Trainer Feedback: Great positioning on transition. Work on weak foot distribution.
mockData.Player Reflection: Felt confident in the first half, but fatigued around the 75th minute.

growth.title: Growth & Actionable Plans
growth.description: Translate match logs into structured growth templates. Track strengths, weaknesses, and improvement areas.
features: List key match strengths to build player confidence
Identify specific weaknesses to target in upcoming training
Formulate explicit improvement areas for action plans

roles.player_desc: Players utilize the tracker to review statistics, enter post-match reflections, and maintain a historical ledger of their pitch minutes, goals, and assists.
roles.trainer_desc: Trainers gain administrative capacity to view player records, add notes, and finalize professional matches by assigning values for intensity, attitude, and performance.
